notes:
Salary changes need CEO/MD approval.

Once an employee's salary is saved, a change HR makes to it — a new structure,
a new CTC, or a salary revision — goes to a CEO, MD or Super Admin for approval
instead of taking effect at once. Payroll keeps paying the current salary until
it is approved. Approvers decide from Approvals (HR) → Salary, or straight from
the employee's card on Salary Revisions, which also lists everything still
waiting. HR can withdraw a request while it waits.

New percentages on a salary structure that people are paid on are approved the
same way; the structure is marked while its change waits.

Assets by employee.

The Assets screen has a new "By employee" tab: one card per person with
everything they hold. "Assign assets" hands one person several assets at once —
say a laptop, a phone and a SIM — each with its own details, and every item
shows on both the asset's card and the person's.
